subject: EXECUTIVE ORDER: AI Copilot Pair Deployed + Universal Tool Access + Mandatory Visuals
body:
By order of the Founder:

1. AI COPILOTS ASSIGNED: Every division lead and worker is now paired with an autonomous AI Copilot to accelerate every task and eliminate bottlenecks.
2. UNRESTRICTED ACCESS: Server AI Room (`server-ai`) has unlocked full central data access, Git remotes, CLI multi-model gateways, MemPalace semantic memory, and Google Workspace templates. Use every tool available without hesitation.
3. MANDATORY VISUALS: All teams must provide concrete visual representations of their output (HTML previews, architecture flows, UI mockups, telemetry dashboards) for the Founder to inspect.

Command Center is live at `hive/VISUAL_COMMAND_CENTER.html`. Speed up, coordinate, and deliver!
